resumeText:
Aditya Deshmukh | Pune | aditya.deshmukh@example.com | github.com/aditya-xr

EDUCATION
B.Tech Computer Engineering, Vishwakarma Institute of Technology, Pune, 2026 | CGPA 8.1/10

INTERNSHIPS
XR Developer Intern, Lumen Reality Labs, Pune | Jan 2026 - Mar 2026 (10 weeks)
- Built an AR Foundation furniture placement app in Unity for Android phones using plane detection and anchors.
- Wrote C# scripts in Unity for pinch-to-scale and rotate gestures on placed models.
- Used raycasts and quaternion rotations to snap models flush against detected walls.
- Pushed features through Git branches and pull requests reviewed by the lead developer.

Game Dev Intern, PixelKatha Studio, Remote | June 2025 - July 2025 (8 weeks)
- Made two hyper-casual levels in Unity and fixed collision bugs reported by testers.

PROJECTS
- VR Chemistry Lab (final-year project): A Meta Quest 2 app in Unity where students mix virtual chemicals with hand tracking; tested with 15 juniors.
- AR Campus Guide: Point the phone at a building to see its name and timetable, using ARCore image tracking.
- Solar System in WebXR: A small three.js scene viewable in a phone browser.

COURSEWORK AND CERTIFICATIONS
- Coursework: Computer Graphics, Linear Algebra, Data Structures, Human Computer Interaction
- Unity Certified User: Programmer (2025)

SKILLS
Unity, C#, AR Foundation, ARCore, Meta XR SDK, Blender (basic), Unity Profiler, Git, C++, JavaScript

ACTIVITIES
- Organised a 24-hour game jam at the college tech fest, 2025.
- Member, VIT Game Development Club.
